description: This file defines the ManagedEventReassignmentService class responsible for handling automatic reassignment of managed events, including fetching bookings, validating event types, finding eligible users, and performing reassignments.

classes.name: ManagedEventReassignmentService
classes.description: Service class for managing automatic reassignment of events, including fetching bookings, validating event types, selecting users, and executing reassignments.

methods.name: executeAutoReassignment
methods.description: Performs automatic reassignment of a booking to an eligible user, including validation, fetching event type chain, finding users, and selecting a user for reassignment.

methods.name: fetchAndValidateBookingForReassignment
methods.description: Fetches a booking by ID and validates its existence and event type.

methods.name: fetchManagedEventTypeChain
methods.description: Retrieves the current child event type and its parent, ensuring the parent is a managed event type.

methods.name: findEligibleReassignmentUsers
methods.description: Finds users eligible for reassignment within a parent event type, filtering by schedules and delegation credentials.

methods.name: selectReassignmentUser
methods.description: Selects a user for reassignment using a lucky user service.
